title: Geo-expansion spec
description: The single input contract shared by the geo-expansion-pr skill family (source, unit-tests, functional-tests). Authored from a PRD. Read by tools/scripts/apply-geo-*.js. Content and functional expectations must agree on identical literals, which is why one spec drives all three skills rather than chaining them.

jira.description: Mandatory. Supplied by the user; never derived from the branch, the PRD, or anything else. Used for the branch name feature/<jira>-geo-expansion-<cc>.

mode.description: new-country: full locale tree + registration (ref PR #1276). new-product: add a product to a country that already exists (ref PR #1321). modal-only: a single modal view (ref PR #1310, #1305) — stops before src/components/modal/v2.

countryName.description: Human-readable name used only in the // <CC> - <Name> banner comments, e.g. Austria.

templateCountry.description: The existing country whose locale tree is cloned. Required for mode new-country. Choose by language and product shape, not alphabetically — AT clones DE.

currency.description: ISO 4217, e.g. EUR. Used only for human-readable output; formatting comes from the content files.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag written into meta.language of content files, e.g. de-AT.

localeClass.description: Value of localeClass in src/server/locale/<CC>/**/index.js. Defaults to locale--<targetCountry>.

productName.description: The productName tuple in the locale module, e.g. ['mit', 'PayPal.'] for AT. Localized — must come from the PRD or the template country's copy, never invented.

crossBorder.description: Whether this market has non-<CC> (cross-border) message variants. Doubles the mutation module count and adds the :NON-<CC> offerType keys.

name.description: Directory name under src/server/locale/<CC>/, e.g. GPL or Pi30. Omitted for countries whose locale module is flat (GB has mutations/ directly).

offerType.description: The OFFER.* constant this product dispatches on, e.g. PAY_LATER_PAY_IN_1.

rendersAs.description: Drives which of the hardcoded arrays in the four snapshot specs this product's account joins. 'accordion' is the European long-term shape.

mutations.description: One entry per mutation module. This list is the source of truth for the unit-test coverage matrix — every entry must end up with both a jest.mock block and a test.each row.

file.description: Module basename without .js, e.g. gpl_eqz or pi30q-non-at.

offerTypeKey.description: The colon-style dispatch key this module answers to, e.g. GPL:EQZ. Must match a case label in mutations/index.js — the unit test asserts getMutations returns ['text', locale, offerTypeKey].

v2Code.description: The parallel v2 case label, e.g. PLLT_NQ_EZ. Emitted alongside offerTypeKey in the switch.

content.description: Layer 1. content/ is a dev fixture tree consumed only by utils/devServerProxy — it never ships. Fixtures must still match production copy closely, because snapshot baselines bake in whatever they say.

devAccounts.description: Layer 4. Keys are generated to the 13-character rule and validated, not authored. Supply only the semantic parts.

slug.description: The meaningful tail, e.g. ATPLEQZ or XBATPI30NQ. The generator left-pads DEV + zeros to reach exactly 13 characters.

v2Name.description: The v2 logical account name, e.g. DEV_AT_LONG_TERM. Underscore style, not length-constrained.

v2ContentFile.description: Optional 4th tuple element when the v2 content file differs from the v1 one.

scenarios.description: Which functional scenario families apply. Derived from the PRD — write only what it calls for, nothing speculative.

contentSource.description: Provenance only — not consumed by any script.

umcRef.description: upstream-message-content ref checked for a counterpart. Expect a miss for new markets: across the four reference PRs only 2 of 24 added content files had one.

figmaUrl.description: Figma frame the copy was transcribed from, when UMC had no counterpart.

interactive.description: false for orchestrator runs: no prompts, no gates, terminal line is PR_URL= or ERROR=.

cloneFrom.description: Path relative to content/ to clone structure from. Copy is still replaced from the PRD or Figma; only shape is inherited.

source.description: Which rung of the ladder actually supplied the copy.
